content: Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to place 5 pegs into a pegboard independently in 4 out of 5 opportunities to enhance fine motor precision and hand-eye coordination.
Within six months, Sabrina will jump forward with both feet together covering a distance of at least 6 inches in 4 out of 5 attempts, promoting gross motor skill development and lower body strength.

Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate improved sensory processing and regulation by independently engaging in a variety of sensory-rich play activities (e.g., sand play, water play) for a minimum of 10 minutes, in 4 out of 5 sessions.

Within six months, Sabrina will dress herself with minimal assistance, successfully putting on and taking off a simple pullover shirt in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing self-care abilities and independence.

Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to use age-appropriate play schemes with peers by engaging in at least one turn-taking game independently in 4 out of 5 play sessions, supporting social participation and cooperative play.
Within three months, Sabrina will use both hands together to complete simple bilateral activities (e.g., clapping games, rolling a ball) across midline with minimal cues in 4 out of 5 opportunities.
Within six months, Sabrina will hold a spoon with a more functional grip and bring it to her mouth with minimal assistance in 4 out of 5 meal times, supporting mealtime independence.

Within six months, Sabrina will demonstrate the ability to follow simple one-step instructions during structured play activities with no more than 1 prompt in 4 out of 5 opportunities, reinforcing language comprehension and adaptive functioning.
